name: smoke
note: Three cases. The smoke test's job is to prove the serving route works end to end before the suite is spent on it: one noul, one choice, one score, plus the labelled applicability question that must come back 'yes' for GDPR and 'no' for NIS2.

cases.state: I was charged twice this month, please refund one of them.

criteria.technical: Product bugs, outages and integration problems.
